participant-mobile-menu.title: Navigation
participant-mobile-menu.description: Here you find the navigation with all important functions.

participant-role-switch.title: Switch roles at any time
participant-role-switch.description: You start in the “Sell” area. With BazarPro you can take part in bazaars as well as create your own. Switch the area here at any time.

participant-participant-nav.title: Navigation
participant-participant-nav.description: Switch quickly between all functions for participants. Take part in bazaars as a seller and manage your items conveniently online.

participant-new-product.title: Create a new item
participant-new-product.description: Create a new item with title, description, price and pictures. Then assign it to one or more bazaars.

participant-first-product.title: View and edit your item
participant-first-product.description: Edit your item at any time – e.g. to change the price or add it to a bazaar. Click the item to open the public view. It shows you how customers see your item.

participant-first-product-qr.title: QR code for your item
participant-first-product-qr.description: Every item has a QR code that identifies it on site at a bazaar. Print it and attach it to the item. Customers can scan the code and see all details of the item. Organizers can scan the code to handle a sale.

participant-nav-events-search.title: Discover bazaars
participant-nav-events-search.description: “Bazaars” takes you to the bazaar overview. There you can find suitable bazaars and register as a seller.

participant-events-search.title: Register for a bazaar
participant-events-search.description: Find suitable bazaars and register as a seller. Afterwards you can offer your items there.

participant-finish.title: That's it!
participant-finish.description: You can get started now: register for your first bazaar and add your items. If you need help again later, you can restart the tutorial at any time via the icon at the bottom right.

organizer-role-switch.title: Switch roles at any time
organizer-role-switch.description: Perfect! We have already selected the “Organize” area for you. With BazarPro you can take part in bazaars as well as organize bazaars yourself. Switch the area here at any time.

organizer-new-event-button.title: Create a new bazaar
organizer-new-event-button.description: Start a new bazaar here. Click “New bazaar” to define title, location, dates and further details.

organizer-new-event-details.title: Fill in the bazaar details
organizer-new-event-details.description: Give your bazaar a clear title and a description. Your participants will see this information later – keep it precise and appealing.

panel.intro: Let us quickly show you around!
panel.question: What would you like to do first?
panel.organizerHint: Set up a bazaar and invite sellers.
panel.stopTitle: Do you really want to end the tour?
panel.stopShort: It only takes 1–2 minutes and helps you get started quickly.
panel.stopRestart: You can restart the tour at any time with the button at the bottom right if you need help later.
